titles.romaji: ASTRO BOY: Tetsuwan Atom - 10-man Kounen no Raihousha - IGZA
titles.native: ASTRO BOY 鉄腕アトム 10万光年の来訪者・IGZA

description: Japan's first fully animated IMAX anime film. Interplanetary spacecraft Galileo II is heading for Saturn's largest moon Titan. However the machines on the moon are trying to destroy humans, so Atom must go and fix the problem.
